config.source: the mandatory NeurIPS checklist question on experiment statistical significance, parsed from the paper PDF
config.sample: partial run, 1276 of 2000 papers extracted so far; 535 NeurIPS papers with a parsed answer
config.venue_caveat: NeurIPS and ICML differ in more than the checklist, so the venue contrast is associational and not causal

notes: Two results. Of papers declaring they report error bars, 61 percent print none in any results table and only a fifth of those point to figures. And only 7 papers that answered No do have table error bars, so the extractor agrees with author self-report on 142 of 149 cases, a precision check at a scale visual inspection cannot reach.
